dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-back toward the posterior peduncle at the bottom of the frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-mid grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal area, typical of sub-adult or near-mature coloration.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, semi-circular loss of tissue or deep indentation is visible on the left lateral margin of the mid-dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: The sharp, asymmetrical notch on the left lateral edge serves as a unique diagnostic feature for individual identification.
